question: Should `plugin.approval.cancel` and `decision: null` on `plugin.approval.resolved` be accepted as the permanent gateway/plugin SDK contract for aborted requester cleanup?
rationale: This bug fix crosses the gateway protocol and plugin SDK boundary, so maintainers need to confirm whether nullable resolved events are the intended public contract before it ships.

options.title: Accept nullable cancel contract
options.body: Keep the new cancel RPC and nullable resolved event, but require docs, contract coverage, and sibling-waiter cancellation before merge.

options.title: Keep cancellation internal
options.body: Rework the fix so aborted requester cleanup does not widen the public plugin resolved-event contract without a separate API decision.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Hold this branch until maintainers choose a broader approval lifecycle design for aborted plugin requests.

recommendation.title: Accept nullable cancel contract
recommendation.body: Keep the new cancel RPC and nullable resolved event, but require docs, contract coverage, and sibling-waiter cancellation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged and hardened the original plugin approval contract and is the clearest routing owner for the API compatibility choice.
